title: P0.33: Startup truth refresh bounded by timeout
description: Live runtime showed UIBridge unavailable after restart because startup_truth_refresh stayed active while PortableContextService.build_package() was still running. That flag paused lazy VM prebuild and prevented runtime wiring from converging. The fix bounds each truth-refresh step and clears _truth_refresh_active in finally.
resume_hint: Completed in local Windows runtime. _final_startup_truth_refresh now runs OSES and PortableContext steps with a daemon-thread timeout and always clears _truth_refresh_active.
next_action: Run IABV from the desktop shortcut and confirm runtime_audit no longer accumulates lazy_vm_prebuild_paused with reason startup_background_active:startup_truth_refresh after the timeout window.
reason: Metacognitive refresh must be observable and bounded. A stuck PortableContext rebuild should be recorded and degraded, not block bridge wiring or lazy VM prebuild.
